name: 問題数と出題形式を決めるテスト設定
prompt:
Create a faithful 390 × 700 px Japanese quiz-test settings component. Reference 1 is the authoritative native preview for geometry, text, switch states and spacing. Return the component canvas only, without a phone frame or surrounding app screen.

The user dislikes tint colors. Keep the full canvas and all empty areas pure white #FFFFFF. Use no pale cream, mint, blush, pale green, gray or blue tinted surface fills, gradients, glow, shadow or texture. Keep active switches and primary actions flat solid forest green #047857. Keep inactive switch tracks neutral #E4E4E4 with white knobs. Value text is forest green; all ordinary text is #1D1D1D, subtitle #6E6E6E.

Match exact 390×700 layout: title x=16/y=8, 358×28, Meiryo Bold 20/28, “テストを設定”. Subtitle x=16/y=52, 358×16, Meiryo Regular 12/16, #6E6E6E, “健康と暮らしの用語集”.

Question-count row: label x=16/y=104, 254×24, Meiryo Regular 14/24, “問題数”; right value x=278/y=104, 96×24, same font and line height, green #047857, “15問　⌄”. Instant-feedback row: label x=16/y=162, 284×24, “答えたらすぐ判定する”; ON switch x=314/y=160, 54×30, 15 px corners, green track with 22×22 white knob at x=340/y=164, 11 px corners. Answer-format row: label x=16/y=216, 254×24, “解答に使うもの”; right value x=278/y=216, 96×24, green #047857, “定義　⌄”.

Question-type rows in Meiryo Regular 14/24: “正誤問題” x=16/y=290 with OFF switch x=314/y=288; neutral #E4E4E4 track 54×30, white 22×22 knob at x=318/y=292. “選択問題” x=16/y=342 with ON switch x=314/y=340; solid green track and white knob x=340/y=344. “記述問題” x=16/y=394 with OFF switch x=314/y=392; neutral track and white knob x=318/y=396. All switches have pill tracks and 11 px rounded knobs.

Preserve the large white gap below the options. Primary button x=16/y=638, 358×44, 10 px corners, flat solid #047857. Center white Meiryo Regular 14/24 text “テストを始める” at x=24/y=648 in a 342×24 line box. Keep exact Japanese copy, state selection and compact alignment. Add no dividers, cards, icons, or extra content.
reviewNotes: Initial 0155 candidate keeps white and neutral surfaces, but green controls have tonal texture; one targeted correction follows.
